t.zh: 处理照片边缘时，窗口的一部分会落到画面之外。如果仍要保留原图尺寸，应如何处理缺失的邻居？本关采用<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>中的补零规则；比较边缘与内部的相同输入，观察输出是否仍然相同。
t.en: At a photograph’s edge, part of the processing window falls outside the image. How should missing neighbours be handled if the output is to retain the original size? Use zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>, then compare equal inputs at the edge and in the interior.

desc.zh: 输入一张图和左、中、右三个权重 a、b、c，输出和原图一样大：每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image and the left, centre and right weights a, b, c; gives an output as large as the image, a × left + b × here + c × right at each position, 0 outside

after.zh: 尺寸保住了，边界却加入了人为假设：补零会在边缘引入与内部不同的邻居。输出两端变暗不能直接当成场景中的真实边缘，后面找变化时也必须记得这一点。 (<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>)
after.en: The size is preserved, but an artificial boundary assumption was added. Zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref> introduces neighbours unlike the interior. Darkened ends need not be real scene boundaries; remember this when detecting changes.

brief.zh: 三个权重都是 1/3（求左中右的平均），图外补 0：写出和原图一样宽的结果。
brief.en: All three weights 1/3 (the average of left, here and right), 0 outside: write the result, as wide as the row.

hint.zh: 最左一格的左邻在图外，算作 0。
hint.en: The leftmost cell's left neighbour is outside and counts as 0.

why.zh: 这是图外取最近的边：题目约定图外补 0，两端只有两个 3 和一个 0，平均是 2。
why.en: That reads the nearest edge outside: here 0 is padded outside, so each end averages two 3s and a 0, giving 2.

t.zh: <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>可以在元件上设成出界取 0。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> can be set on the part to read 0 outside the image.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：输出和原图一样宽，每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻，图外补 0。
brief.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give an output as wide as the image, a × left + b × here + c × right at each position, 0 outside.

hint.zh: 这回输出的第 x 格就以原图的 x 为中心。
hint.en: Now the output's cell x is centred on the original x.
